# Support for DecisionPilot AI

Thank you for using **DecisionPilot AI**!

## Getting Help

- 📖 **Documentation**: Explore guides in [`docs/`](../docs/), including [System Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [Data Dictionary](../docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md), [API Reference](../docs/API.md), [Operations Manual](../docs/operations.md), and the [Interactive Docs Portal](https://nguyentribaothang.github.io/DecisionPilotAI/).
- 💬 **GitHub Discussions**: Ask architectural questions, share business use cases, and propose ideas.
